continuity_scenarios.title: Provider Platform Outage Continuity Scenario
continuity_scenarios.preserved_work: In-flight affiliation applications and their evidence are preserved and never silently discarded.
continuity_scenarios.prohibited_action: No destructive action, no silent status mutation, and no bypass of governed transitions during the outage.
continuity_scenarios.degraded_mode: A controlled degraded mode that accepts intake but defers decisions with participant notification.
continuity_scenarios.fallback: A defined fallback that queues governed work for later processing under retained provenance.
continuity_scenarios.recovery: A defined recovery that reconciles queued work against governed state before resuming decisions.

backups.completion: A backup is complete when the defined dataset has been captured to the defined target with a recorded manifest.
backups.verification: A backup is verified only when its integrity and completeness have been independently checked against the manifest.

restores.restoration: Restoration reproduces a verified dataset in a target environment without asserting business recovery or reconciliation.

recoveries.recovery: Recovery returns the governed service to an accepted operating state with reconciled state and retained evidence.
recoveries.reconciliation: Recovery depends on a completed reconciliation of restored state.
